title: "Dirty, Funny and Unpredictably Violent": Gary Oldman and Brad Pitt's "Unapologetic" Thrilller is on Netflix
text: Gary Oldman and Brad Pitt's Cult-Classic Thrilller is on Netflix Search Newsletter Events Subscribe Style Culture Food and Drink Journal Watches Long Reads Design Life News Esquire Shops Follow Privacy Notice Cookies Policy About Us Other Editions Privacy Notice Terms Of Use Skip to Content Better Men Style Culture Watches Grooming Subscribe sign in The Esquire newsletters Clothes to shop Restaurants to book Watches to wear Culture Film "Dirty, Funny and Unpredictably Violent": Gary Oldman and Brad Pitt's "Unapologetic" Thrilller is on Netflix "Dirty, Funny and Unpredictably Violent": Gary Oldman and Brad Pitt's "Unapologetic" Thrilller is on Netflix This thrilling, ridiculous crime drama will have you on the edge of your seat By Josh Osman Published: 19 October 2026 Save Article Juan Naharro Gimenez Back in 1993, Gary Oldman and Brad Pitt starred in their first (and so far, only) project together: a twisty, breakneck crime thriller that failed at the box office but has since become a bona fide cult classic. That film was True Romance . If you’re dying for a rewatch, or haven't yet seen it, then you're in luck – the movie has just landed on Netflix UK. Here’s everything you need to know about it before you dive in. What is True Romance about? The film, directed by Tony Scott and penned by Quentin Tarantino, follows a pair of newlyweds who embark on a road trip from Detroit to California to flee the mafia after they accidentally run off with a suitcase filled with stolen drugs. To give away much more of the plot would do an injustice to the many twists this one makes, but it’s a romantic crime thriller that’s sure to keep you on your toes. Who is in the cast of True Romance ? Christian Slater as Clarence Worley Patricia Arquette as Alabama Whitman Dennis Hopper as Clifford Worley Gary Oldman as Drexl Spivey Michael Rapaport as Dick Ritchie Brad Pitt as Floyd, Dick’s roommate Christopher Walken as Vincenzo Coccotti Samuel L. Jackson as Don "Big Don" James Gandolfini as Virgil What have critics said about True Romance ? Highly regarded for its sense of humour, bizarre narrative and thrills, True Romance is a near-universally acclaimed cult classic. It currently has an approval rating of 93 per cent from both critics and audiences on review aggregation website Rotten Tomatoes, where the consensus reads: "Fueled by Quentin Tarantino 's savvy screenplay and a gallery of oddball performances, Tony Scott's True Romance is a funny and violent action jaunt in the best sense." In a four-star retrospective review, Kate Muir of The Times wrote that "Quentin Tarantino's dirty, funny and unpredictably violent genius powers True Romance ", while Janet Maslin of The New York Times , in a positive review, commented: "This film's various outrages are committed unapologetically, and are very much in service of its bizarre story." Peter Travers of Rolling Stone gave the film three out of four stars, writing that "it’s Tarantino’s gutter poetry that detonates True Romance ", calling the film "dynamite". If that doesn’t sell the film’s explosive, exciting narrative to you, we don’t know what will. Where can I stream True Romance ? True Romance is available to stream on Netflix , but if you aren’t subscribed, you can rent it on Apple TV+ or Prime Video .
